about: Freeze 2 of demo/annex: scene.py with its add-on paths written whole (ROOT / 'adapters/stdlib/stack/stack.py') where freeze 1 (FROZEN.json, unchanged) built them part by part. Committed alone, after freeze 1's scored run and before the run it is scored on again. Held by test_annex.py; a change is a new freeze.
why: test-impact reads a bare 'stack.py' string as every file by that name, so scene.py counted as naming demo/bernadette/stack.py, and a change to what_changed.py planned demo:annex and failed adapters/stdlib/test-impact/test_impact.py::test_the_steps_are_ordered_cheapest_first on this pull request's CI. The same paths as one string, as demo/johnson writes them, name only the add-on's own file. The rules, the checks and every other file are unchanged: the diff against freeze 1 is the four path constants (STACK, FIXITY, APPROVED, SHARE).
known_when_frozen: freeze 1's scored run: R1 to R8 all pass, on the code freeze 1 held. Nothing was changed in a rule or a check after seeing it.
